# Bartosz

> Builds LLM and agent tooling, local-first web apps and small command-line
> tools. Recurring theme: a claim is not a result — the tools measure and
> verify rather than assert.

This file lists the same projects the page shows, generated from the same
source, with the date of each project's last push. Source code for all of
them: https://github.com/bmmmm

## LLM & agent tooling

Instrumenting, measuring and fact-checking what models actually do.

- [wallii](https://github.com/bmmmm/wallii): append-only message wall for agents: NDJSON feed plus a CLI to post, tail and browse it. (Go, last push 2026-09-02)
- [comparereleaseii](https://github.com/bmmmm/comparereleaseii): fact-check release notes against the diff that shipped — GitHub, Forgejo, GitLab or any git clone. Live: https://bmmmm.github.io/comparereleaseii/demo/ (TypeScript, last push 2026-09-01)
- [claudii](https://github.com/bmmmm/claudii): statusline for Claude Code: session cost, context %, rate limits, model health. Pure bash + jq, zero daemons. Live: https://bmmmm.github.io/claudii/ (Shell, last push 2026-09-01)
- [check0r3000](https://github.com/bmmmm/check0r3000): LLM extraction of comparable facts out of insurance terms, benchmarked against golden files. Finding so far: what you feed the model matters more than which model. (Python, last push 2026-09-01)
- [bumpii](https://github.com/bmmmm/bumpii): reads what changed in the tools you run and keeps only what touches the features you use. (TypeScript, last push 2026-09-01)
- [gateii](https://github.com/bmmmm/gateii): minimal self-hosted proxy in front of LLM APIs — OpenResty, Prometheus, Grafana. (Lua, last push 2026-08-23)
- [cc-insomnii](https://github.com/bmmmm/cc-insomnii): a bedtime-shaming statusline for Claude Code. (Shell, last push 2026-07-27)

## Backup, recovery & proof

Systems that assume the failure already happened and stay useful anyway.

- [stattii](https://github.com/bmmmm/stattii): attestation over an event calendar — cancellations propagate outward with delivery proof. (Go, last push 2026-09-02)
- [how-small-can-we-go](https://github.com/bmmmm/how-small-can-we-go): trust-golf: one champion per task, dethroned by needing less trust. Measured, never claimed. Live: https://bmmmm.github.io/how-small-can-we-go/ (Go, last push 2026-08-10)
- [baaackaaab](https://github.com/bmmmm/baaackaaab): one-way, ransomware-resistant iCloud backup: Drive and Photos into an append-only restic store. (Swift, last push 2026-08-06)
- [revertii](https://github.com/bmmmm/revertii): update a service with the way back built in: snapshot, dead man's switch, health-check, revert. (Shell, last push 2026-08-04)

## Local-first web apps

Static pages that keep your data in your own browser.

- [kuvertii](https://github.com/bmmmm/kuvertii): read what an email header says about you — who it was really addressed to, where the unsubscribe link leads. Live: https://bmmmm.github.io/kuvertii/ (JavaScript, last push 2026-09-02)
- [putzii](https://github.com/bmmmm/putzii): cleaning schedule shared by capability link, with QR check-in. No backend at all. Live: https://bmmmm.github.io/putzii/ (JavaScript, last push 2026-09-02)
- [gymii](https://github.com/bmmmm/gymii): floor-plan your gym, log sets against numbered machines. Offline-first, data never leaves the device. Live: https://bmmmm.github.io/gymii/ (JavaScript, last push 2026-09-01)
- [musiclinkii](https://github.com/bmmmm/musiclinkii): turn one music link into links for every streaming platform. Live: https://bmmmm.github.io/musiclinkii/ (JavaScript, last push 2026-08-22)
- [shieldchipiii](https://github.com/bmmmm/shieldchipiii): stone-chip logbook for your windshield, so the insurance conversation has a record instead of a memory. Live: https://bmmmm.github.io/shieldchipiii/ (JavaScript, last push 2026-07-18)
- [app-icons-generator](https://github.com/bmmmm/app-icons-generator): every iOS, macOS and watchOS icon size from one 1024px PNG — CLI and browser. Live: https://bmmmm.github.io/app-icons-generator/ (Shell, last push 2026-07-18)
- [db-wallet](https://github.com/bmmmm/db-wallet): drink tracking wallet for the crowd at bitcircus101.de and Datenburg e.V. Bonn. Live: https://bmmmm.github.io/db-wallet/ (JavaScript, last push 2026-07-17)

## Terminal & macOS

Things that live in a shell, or in the menu bar next to it.

- [pegel-visual](https://github.com/bmmmm/pegel-visual): live ASCII water levels for German rivers, with an optional aircraft overlay from your own ADS-B receiver. Live: https://bmmmm.github.io/pegel-visual/ (JavaScript, last push 2026-09-01)
- [youtubehistii](https://github.com/bmmmm/youtubehistii): local YouTube watch-history analyzer — topics, and consume vs. learn. Fully on-device. (Go, last push 2026-08-31)
- [epcii](https://github.com/bmmmm/epcii): EPC QR code (GiroCode) generator — one static binary with its own QR encoder core. (Go, last push 2026-08-31)
- [pwdtintii](https://github.com/bmmmm/pwdtintii): the terminal background takes its colour from the directory you are in. zsh, bash, fish, tmux-aware. (Shell, last push 2026-08-23)
- [vpnii](https://github.com/bmmmm/vpnii): VPN status in the zsh prompt, on top of WireGuard and Tailscale. (Shell, last push 2026-08-05)
- [audioctl](https://github.com/bmmmm/audioctl): switch macOS output and input devices, volume, mute and sample rate from the CLI. (Swift, last push 2026-07-27)
- [KeebLock](https://github.com/bmmmm/KeebLock): locks the keyboard while you clean it, with animations worth the thirty seconds. (Swift, last push 2026-07-20)
- [git-times-live](https://github.com/bmmmm/git-times-live): a standalone live broadcast TV channel for your git activity. Live: https://bmmmm.github.io/git-times-live/ (Shell, last push 2026-07-17)

## FreshRSS extensions

Four small extensions for the reader I actually use every day.

- [NoteDrop](https://github.com/bmmmm/xExtension-NoteDrop): drop notes and links on one device, copy them on another with one click. (PHP, last push 2026-09-01)
- [ClickHistory](https://github.com/bmmmm/xExtension-ClickHistory): keeps a history of the article links you actually opened. (PHP, last push 2026-08-28)
- [ShareViaQRCode](https://github.com/bmmmm/xExtension-ShareViaQRCode): a large QR code for the current article, so a phone can pick the link off the screen. (JavaScript, last push 2026-08-25)
- [ExitReaderView](https://github.com/bmmmm/xExtension-ExitReaderView): a floating button to leave the reading view in one click. (JavaScript, last push 2026-08-18)
